slot_scores.name: demand_fulfillment_required
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the market demand for each container type a strict minimum that must be met exactly, or can the total production for a type exceed its listed demand?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether demand must be fully met (Turn 1 also included 'while satisfying all market demands'), clearly covering the demand-fulfillment requirement.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost (sum of variable production costs plus fixed setup costs) while satisfying all market demands?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and its components (variable production costs plus fixed setup costs), fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots (demand fulfillment and cost-minimization objective) were explicitly asked and confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL. Remaining unconfirmed items are minor (integer domain, capacity, minimum production), with no unresolved P0/P1 slots.

summary: The agent asked focused, high-value questions that directly recovered both P0 hidden slots (demand fulfillment and total-cost objective) and confirmed the substitution and setup-cost facts, then stopped appropriately with remaining items noted as assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
